description: Data used for the paper titled 'A FAIR approach for detecting and sharing PFAS hot-spot areas and water systems' (DOI: ...), representing a comprehensive analysis of PFAS contamination across various water systems and hot-spot areas, sourced from peer-reviewed research and environmental monitoring data, covering the period from 2020 to the present. This dataset provides critical insights into the spatial distribution of PFAS levels, aiding stakeholders in informed decision-making and policy development.
